contact.evidence_quote: [Family Photo]Our Founder ... Although Filly Flair is now a large online retailer, it started from humble beginnings. A family-owned business, Filly Flair was founded in 2010 by Laura Benson. At the time, Laura was a single gal with a dream and a vision to create something fabulous. With a plan in mind, Laura established her business headquarters in her basement and began the process of making her dreams a reality.
